title: Low-power occupancy sensor with motion-triggered sensing window
abstract: A PIR detector wakes a high-power sensing element for a fixed window.
description: A battery-powered occupancy sensor keeps its high-power sensing element off. A passive infrared detector wakes the high-power element for a fixed observation window when motion is detected, and the element is switched off again if no occupant is classified within the window.

claims.text: A battery-powered occupancy sensor comprising a passive infrared detector and a high-power sensing element, wherein the passive infrared detector wakes the high-power sensing element for a fixed observation window upon detecting motion, and the high-power sensing element is switched off if no occupant is classified within the window.
